message.content: I'll search for the best way to change a `` color on mouseover using HTML/CSS. Based on my search, I found the standard approach to change a `` color on mouseover. Here's how to do it: ## Pure CSS Solution (Recommended) The cleanest way is using the `:hover` pseudo-class in CSS: ```html Hover over this text! ``` ## Inline Style (Quick but Not Recommended) If you need it inline (though CSS classes are preferred): ```html Hover over this text! ``` ## Key Points | Approach | Best For | Pros | Cons | |----------|----------|------|------| | **CSS `:hover`** | Most cases | Clean, maintainable, no JavaScript | None significant | | **JavaScript events** | Complex logic | Full control | More verbose, harder to maintain | | **Inline styles** | Quick tests only | Self-contained | Hard to maintain, mixes content/presentation | ## CSS-Only Without Class (Any Span) ```css span:hover { color: red; } ``` This applies to **all** spans. Use a class for more control. ## With Smooth Transition ```css span { color: black; transition: color 0.3s ease; /* animates the color change */ } span:hover { color: red; } ``` The CSS `:hover` approach is **strongly recommended** as it: - Separates presentation from content - Works even if JavaScript is disabled - Is easier to maintain and update - Performs better (browser optimizes CSS) Sources: 1. https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/:hover 2. https://www.w3schools.com/cssref/sel_hover.php 3. https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/transition
